kultivator.gabung.perang.kartu.isi: The war drums sound at the gate of %s. Our enemy: %s. The war lasts at most %s days, or until one side reaches a score of 100.

kultivator.gabung.perang.kartu.bebas: Outer Disciples and below are not obliged, but every war mission brings PK and renown. (Inner and above must answer within %s days.)
kultivator.gabung.perang.tombol.lihat.ti: Open your sect's list of war missions
kultivator.gabung.perang.alasan.sekte: That sect is unknown, or it is your own.
kultivator.gabung.perang.alasan.sudah: One of the sects is already at war.

kultivator.gabung.perang.akhir.menang: The war is over! %s defeated %s (score %s). Disciples who fought two war missions or more receive a reward.
kultivator.gabung.perang.akhir.kalah: The war is over. %s lost to %s (score %s). The mountain licks its wounds and swears to rise again.
kultivator.gabung.perang.akhir.seri: The war between %s and %s ended in a draw (score %s).
kultivator.gabung.perang.hadiah.giok: War reward from the Merit Pavilion: %s.
kultivator.gabung.perang.lalai: You ignored the Call to War of %s. The Hall of Discipline records an A4 offence (+%s).
kultivator.gabung.perang.status.bukan: You are not a member of any sect.
kultivator.gabung.perang.status.damai: Your sect is not at war.
kultivator.gabung.perang.status.skor: Score %s · %s days left · brothers captured %s · your missions %s
kultivator.gabung.perang.status.wajib: You must finish one war mission (within %s days of the call).
kultivator.gabung.perang.inspired: Inspired by the sect wars of xianxia stories: the sect's summons, forward posts, champions' duels and captured disciples.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.bela_gerba: Three waves of the enemy march on the compound gate and try to break its seal. Hold all three before the seal gives.
The enemy pitched a camp on the line between the two gates. Beat its four guards, then pull their banner from its pole.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.duel_juara: The enemy's champion, their Eldest Senior or Young Elder, challenges at the compound arena. A sword duel that stops at 10%% health.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.jemput_taw: Our brothers are caged in an enemy camp near their gate. Beat the guards and open the cages.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.kawal_beka: A supply cart leaves the gate for the road post, 140 blocks away. The enemy will ambush it twice; never leave the cart alone.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.alasan.ber: Finish your running war mission first.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.alasan.gar: One of the two sect gates is not known yet.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.alasan.ger: The sect compound's gate has not been found.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.alasan.har: Already done today; come back tomorrow.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.alasan.jen: There is no such war mission.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.alasan.jua: The enemy has no healthy champion right now.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.alasan.taw: None of our brothers is held captive.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.alasan.tem: The mission's place cannot be found.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.alasan.tid: You are not running a war mission.

kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.bar.sergap: Ambush! The cart halts at %s%% · enemies %s
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.batal.duel: The %s duel was called off without a result.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.batal.gala: The %s mission stopped because of an error.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.batal.kelu: The %s mission is off: you left the sect.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.batal.lewa: The %s mission lapsed (a day without starting).
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.batal.tak_: The enemy could not come; the %s mission ends without score.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.batal.usai: The war ended; the %s mission is closed.
Wave %s held! Ready yourself for the next.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.jauh: You strayed from the mission! Come back within 30 seconds.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.juara.data: %s, champion of %s, steps into the arena and salutes.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.juara.mena: %s lowers the sword: "Come back when you are stronger."
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.kalah.gero: The supply cart is lost; %s failed.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.kawal.bera: The cart sets off for the road post at (%s, %s). Stay within 20 blocks of it.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.kawal.tiba: The cart reaches the road post. The guards take over the supplies.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.kawal.tung: The driver waits for the escort: come back to the cart.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.panji.beba: The guards are down. Pull the enemy banner from its pole!
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.panji.lepa: You let go of the banner pole.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.tawanan.am: The camp guards are down. Walk up to the cages to free your brothers.
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.tawanan.te: %s: "Senior, you came! Thank you, I will head back to the mountain."
kultivator.gabung.misi_perang.tombol.bat: Call off the running war mission (no score)
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.alasan.tempat: No hunter squad can appear here.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.alasan.tidak_a: No hunters stand in your way.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.alasan.utusan: No envoy of peace is waiting for you.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.ampun: %s pardons you. You now count as expelled; the hunters are called home.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.berhenti: %s stops hunting you: "Too strong to chase." (%s/%s victories) You remain a recorded deserter.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.menang: The hunters of %s withdraw. Victories %s/%s; they will be back.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.diam: You say nothing. The squad's leader draws a sword.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.sub: The law of %s bars your way
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.kurung.bebas: Your time of reflection in the cave of %s is over.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.kurung.tarik: The guard drags you back into the cave.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.lari: You run! Put %s blocks between you and the squad within %s seconds.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.lawan: You choose to fight. The hunters step up one by one under duel rules (stopping at 10%% health).
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.lolos: You escaped the hunters... for now.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.menyerah.terim: %s: "Wise. The sect still remembers your old service."
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.mundur: The hunters withdraw without a fight.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.serah: You surrender to %s. You now count as expelled; the hunt is over.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.seru: %s: "Traitor! In the name of %s, you are under arrest!"
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.tawar: %s hunters surround you. Surrender means a fine of repentance of %s, the Heritage Technique wiped and the status of the expelled. Answer within 30 seconds:
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.terkejar: They are too fast; they caught up with you!
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.tertangkap: You fall to your knees. %s binds your hands and takes you to the mountain.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.tolak: You turn away the envoy of peace of %s.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.tombol.damai.t: Deserter becomes expelled; the hunt stops
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.tombol.lari.ti: Get 48 blocks away from the squad within 40 seconds
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.tombol.lawan.t: Duel them one by one down to 10%% health
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.tombol.menyera: Pay the fine, lose the Heritage Technique, count as expelled
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.utusan: An envoy of peace from %s finds you: "Our master acknowledges your strength. Come home as an outsider, not as a fugitive."
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.warisan: The Heritage Technique you ran off with fades from your memory.
kultivator.gabung.pemburu.inspired: Inspired by the deserting disciples hunted by their old sects in xianxia stories.
kultivator.gabung.serbuan.alasan.jauh: A live raid needs you within %s blocks of the compound gate.
kultivator.gabung.serbuan.alasan.sudah: That compound is already under attack.
kultivator.gabung.serbuan.data.tahan: News from the mountain: the raid of %s on %s was driven back.
kultivator.gabung.serbuan.data.jebol: News from the mountain: the raid of %s broke the gate of %s. The stores were plundered, but no one fell.
kultivator.gabung.serbuan.live.tahan: The raid of %s is driven back from the gate of %s!
kultivator.gabung.serbuan.live.jebol: The raid of %s broke the gate of %s. The elders held the rest; no one fell.
kultivator.gabung.serbuan.omen: Black smoke rises on the horizon: %s attacks %s! They arrive in %s seconds.
kultivator.gabung.serbuan.tahan_gelomban: Wave %s driven back! They are regrouping...
kultivator.gabung.serbuan.inspired: Inspired by righteous sects raided by demonic cults in xianxia stories.
kultivator.gabung.riwayat.pemburu_menang: Drove off the hunters of %s (%s times)
kultivator.sibuk.gabung.serbuan: Defending the gate from a raid
